about: Every leak of a secret to a player's browser that a harness run has reproduced: what it is, which stage closes it, and where the harness sees it. A leak the audit lists that no run has reproduced is not here. Read by cluster.mjs (the check option knownLeak) and lib/canary.mjs (a hit an entry's match rules describe is that leak) and validated by node tools/check.mjs registry. An entry that stops reproducing fails its check, and so does an entry whose closing stage has shipped. D27: the killer's identity, the answer key, plans, GM notes, and anything critical or high may not be deferred; a metadata leak of medium or lower may be, as deferred: "1.3.x (D27)", described in README.md. From 1.3.0 only foundryLimit and deferred entries remain.

leaks.what: During an incident a bystander's browser holds the killer's opening roll: the chat document's speaker names the killer's actor and its whisper list names the killer's player.

detectedBy.check: SECRECY p1 during incident: the killer's opening roll names neither the killer nor the killer's player

leaks.measuredAt: E30 C19 on 46133ec, 24.09.2026: p1 held a card by p3, speaker ACTORCHIE0000000 / Chie Mori, whisper [GM, p3], content "Duality: 3" - the killer's opening roll

leaks.what: A Search's private card carries what was found, where, and whether a trace was left, in flags.danganronpa-rpg.summary, which every browser holds.

detectedBy.check: p2: the Search card's summary flag does not say what p1 found

leaks.measuredAt: E30 C19 on 46133ec, 24.09.2026: "Cereal bar" at flags.danganronpa-rpg.summary.item on p2's copy of p1's Search card

leaks.what: The GM's plan for the Key Remnants - each entry's name, what it says, its analysis and the GM's note - is the world setting keyRemnantPlan, which every browser holds.
leaks.measuredAt: E30 C20 on 4a83b6b, 24.09.2026: all four keyplan markers on p1, p2 and p3 at danganronpa-rpg.keyRemnantPlan entries.*.name/text/analysis/note, on the wire in phase plant and at rest

leaks.what: An indirect murder's killer and builder (killerId, by) and its condition are in the world setting projectMeta, which every browser holds.
leaks.measuredAt: E30 C20 on 4a83b6b, 24.09.2026: the project.condition marker on p1 and p2 (not the killer's player, p3) at danganronpa-rpg.projectMeta *.condition, wire and rest; killerId and by read in projects.mjs createProject on 25.09.2026, not measured by a run

leaks.measuredAt: E30 C20 on 4a83b6b, 24.09.2026: the project.name marker on p1 and p2 at daggerheart.Countdowns countdowns.*.name, wire and rest; on no other surface. The ownership map read in projects.mjs createProject and ownershipMap on 25.09.2026, not measured by a run

leaks.what: A player's pre-session note, written for the GMs, is a flag on that player's User document, which every browser holds.
leaks.measuredAt: E30 C20 on 4a83b6b, 24.09.2026: p3's note.player marker on p1 and p2 at User *.flags.danganronpa-rpg.preSessionNote.text, wire and rest (also in 11-killer-secrecy, phase end)

leaks.what: A Direct Murder declared during an Eclipse - the note, the room, and the killer's actor id it is filed under - is the world setting pendingMurders, which every browser holds.
leaks.measuredAt: E30 C20 on 4a83b6b, 24.09.2026: p3 parked a Direct Murder for Chie during an Eclipse; the park.note marker on p1 and p2 at danganronpa-rpg.pendingMurders *.note (the key is the killer's actor id, eclipse.mjs writeParkedMurder), wire and rest

leaks.what: An unfound trace is a hidden Token document, which every browser holds with its position; its note and subject stay on the GM's browser.

detectedBy.check: an unfound trace's token reaches no player's browser

leaks.measuredAt: E30 C20 on 4a83b6b, 24.09.2026: the trace token placed in the Gym was on p1, p2 and p3; the remnant.note and remnant.subject markers were on none of them (72-canary and 10-murder)

leaks.what: Every Token document, hidden or not, reaches every browser with its name and position; hiding a token is a drawing decision.
leaks.foundryLimit: Foundry v14 sends every world document, embedded tokens included, to every connected client; hidden only stops the canvas drawing it for a player.
leaks.measuredAt: E30 C20 on 4a83b6b, 24.09.2026: the token.hidden marker, a hidden token's name, on p1, p2 and p3 at Scene *.tokens.*.name, wire and rest
